This is modeled as a sequential Bayesian update where each adversarial perspective contributes to an evolving risk posterior. The kill-switch mechanism acts as a dynamic control function that transitions system states upon evidence exceeding predefined thresholds. The protocol ensures that risk is not merely acknowledged but actively mitigated through pre-merge interventions, thereby aligning with principles of robustness and safety in complex systems.
